# htmx

`htmx.min.js` is htmx 2.0.11 (`dist/htmx.min.js` from the npm package `htmx.org@2.0.11`,
integrity `sha512-Thx/WtpeOQqSrqBCw/A1cwGJGg4UrVa3+sW0GmrM3p4gJgO89ecH4qtbnyzDDWFvBTqjnIMCgELTNt636dtamA==`),
unchanged. It's licensed under the Zero-Clause BSD licence in `LICENSE`. `psst-server` embeds it
and serves it as `/static/htmx.min.js`.

To update it, replace both files from a newer `htmx.org` package and change the version here.
